title.zh: 将莱特省拜拜市镇乌托德村更名为瓜达卢佩村的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Utod in the Municipality of Baybay, Province of Leyte, to Guadalupe
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Utod in the Municipality of Baybay, Province of Leyte, to Guadalupe
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Utod tại Thị trấn Baybay, Tỉnh Leyte thành Guadalupe
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Utod ในเทศบาล Baybay, จังหวัด Leyte เป็น Guadalupe
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Utod di Kotamadya Baybay, Provinsi Leyte menjadi Guadalupe
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Utod di Perbandaran Baybay, Wilayah Leyte menjadi Guadalupe

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2606_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the barrio of Utod in the Municipality of Baybay, Province of Leyte, is changed to Guadalupe.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
